name: FindCustomer
description: Finds a customer using customer id or customer information.

name: RegisterCustomer
description: Registers a new banking customer.

name: UpdateCustomer
description: Updates an existing customer's information.

name: DeleteCustomer
description: Deletes or deactivates a customer record.

name: FindAccount
description: Finds a bank account using its account identifier.

name: OpenAccount
description: Opens a new bank account for a customer.

name: UpdateAccount
description: Updates account information or account settings.

name: CloseAccount
description: Closes an existing bank account.

name: GetAccountBalance
description: Retrieves the current available balance of an account.

name: DepositFunds
description: Deposits money into a bank account.

name: WithdrawFunds
description: Withdraws money from a bank account.

name: TransferFunds
description: Transfers money between two bank accounts.

name: FindTransaction
description: Finds a banking transaction using its transaction identifier.

name: GetTransactionHistory
description: Retrieves transaction history for an account.

name: CancelTransaction
description: Cancels an eligible banking transaction.

name: ValidateCustomer
description: Validates customer information and required banking details.

name: VerifyIdentity
description: Verifies the identity of a banking customer.

name: ValidateAccount
description: Validates whether a bank account is active and usable.

name: CheckAccountStatus
description: Checks the current status of a bank account.

name: CheckSufficientFunds
description: Checks whether an account has sufficient funds for a transaction.

name: CheckTransferEligibility
description: Checks whether a transfer is allowed between two accounts.

name: FindBeneficiary
description: Finds a registered transfer beneficiary.

name: AddBeneficiary
description: Adds a beneficiary for a customer account.

name: RemoveBeneficiary
description: Removes a beneficiary from an account.

name: CreatePayment
description: Creates a payment instruction from a bank account.

name: ProcessPayment
description: Processes an eligible payment.

name: RefundPayment
description: Refunds an eligible payment.

name: CheckPaymentStatus
description: Checks the current status of a payment.

name: IssueCard
description: Issues a debit or credit card for a customer account.

name: FindCard
description: Finds a banking card using its identifier.

name: ActivateCard
description: Activates an issued banking card.

name: BlockCard
description: Blocks a banking card to prevent further transactions.

name: UnblockCard
description: Unblocks an eligible banking card.

name: CreateLoanApplication
description: Creates a loan application for a customer.

name: ValidateLoanApplication
description: Validates a loan application against required criteria.

name: ApproveLoan
description: Approves an eligible loan application.

name: RejectLoan
description: Rejects a loan application that does not meet approval criteria.

name: DisburseLoan
description: Disburses an approved loan amount to an account.

name: MakeLoanPayment
description: Records a payment toward an outstanding loan.

name: GetLoanBalance
description: Retrieves the outstanding balance of a loan.

name: CreateDeposit
description: Creates a deposit record for a customer account.

name: CreateWithdrawal
description: Creates a withdrawal request for a customer account.

name: GenerateStatement
description: Generates a bank statement for an account.

name: GenerateTransactionReceipt
description: Generates a receipt for a completed transaction.

name: SendEmail
description: Sends an email notification to a banking customer.

name: SendSMS
description: Sends an SMS notification to a banking customer.

name: NotifyCustomer
description: Notifies a customer about a banking event.

name: AuditTransaction
description: Stores an audit log entry for a banking transaction or operation.

name: FlagSuspiciousTransaction
description: Flags a transaction for fraud or compliance review.

name: CreateComplianceCase
description: Creates a compliance review case for a customer or transaction.
